android.desc:
PlantScan - AI powered Plant Identification!

🌿 Discover with Precision:
Our main task is to provide you with the highest identification accuracy. Unleash the power of the latest cutting-edge AI and ML models for accurate plant identification!

📸 Double Snap Accuracy:
Our technology allows you to capture up to two pictures per plant. Coupled with GPS coordinates and time of day, we are able to further enhance identification performance.

🌐 Wide Catalog Reach:
Our identification catalog covers over 33,000 plant species!

🌱 Professional's Choice:
Trusted by landscape design experts for its unparalleled accuracy.

📲 Simplicity at its Best:
Enjoy an uncluttered interface for a seamless and user-friendly experience.

Elevate your botanical exploration – download now and embark on a journey of precision and simplicity with our advanced plant identification app!

quotes.text:
I have very recently published a mobile plant identification app (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hiddengardens.plantscan).

It's the first mobile app I have ever written and I enjoyed the process quite a bit!

My main goal was to deliver better identification accuracy than similar apps.

However I also wanted to provide useful plant information along with the identification and naively thought that this would have had to be a solved problem - surely there would be some online DB with all plants data neatly organized (I'd be even happy to pay for it!), in particular plant care information - but alas!
quotes.story_title: Show HN: A free site to explore and discover 6k plants
